paper_theorem.title: Theorem 1 (Monotonicity)
paper_theorem.statement: Let k > 0. For integers n_a >= 2, the function r(n_a) = (k*n_a*(n_a-1))/2 is strictly increasing in n_a.

lean_theorem.name: rate_strictly_increasing
lean_theorem.type_signature: (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) → ∀ n m : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → n < m → rate k n < rate k m
lean_theorem.definition_of_rate: def rate (k : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := k * (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2

correspondence.paper_variable_k: Lean: k : ℝ with hypothesis hk : 0 < k
correspondence.paper_variable_n_a: Lean: n : ℕ with hypothesis hn : 2 ≤ n
correspondence.paper_rate_formula: Lean: rate k n = k * (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2
correspondence.paper_increasing_property: Lean: ∀ n m : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → n < m → rate k n < rate k m
